theme_and_concept.name: Barbershop Noir (Luxury / Performance Pro)
theme_and_concept.description: A high-contrast, deep dark mode interface tailored for a premium barbershop management system. The design must feel professional, masculine, and sleek. It relies on deep obsidian backgrounds, off-black surfaces, and high-visibility vintage gold/amber accents to guide user attention quickly. Designed for speed: attendants must be able to perform POS actions in high-density grids with minimal clicks.

typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule: Professional yet aggressive.

colors.strategy: High contrast dark mode. Avoid fully black (#000000), use tinted greys. Brand color is used sparingly for primary actions.

layouts.grid_system: Mode B: High Density Grid. Designed for fast scanning and minimum white-space waste on desktop monitors.
layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar. 250px width. Deepest background (#09090B). Must contain full navigation menu with distinct active states (Gold text, subtle gold background tint).

dashboard_bento.kpis: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Cards must be flat, 1px border (#27272A), no heavy shadows.
dashboard_bento.charts: col-span-full md:col-span-2 or 3 for main revenue graph. col-span-1 for pie charts (services breakdown).
dashboard_bento.appointments: col-span-full md:col-span-1 row-span-2. Vertical list format, highly scannable.

layouts.pos_system: Atendimento/Venda rápida module needs massive hit targets. Grid of services (col-span-1, aspect-square or rectangle) with large icons and price.
layouts.spacing: Use p-4 to p-6 for inner card paddings. Use gap-4 for dense data grids, gap-8 for page sections.

components.surfaces: Neumorphic/Technical mix: Flat backgrounds with sharp 1px borders (border-zinc-800). Max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg). NEVER use Glassmorphism for data-heavy sections.
components.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-md). Primary buttons use Vintage Gold. Secondary buttons use transparent background with 1px border.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Dense rows. Hover state on rows must be a subtle lightness bump (hover:bg-zinc-800/50). Zebra striping is permitted for readability.
components.forms: Shadcn Forms. Inputs must have clear visible borders (border-zinc-700). Focus states must ring in Gold (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37]).
components.calendar: Custom full-screen or large-scale component for Agendamentos. Must distinctively show available vs booked slots using color intensity.
components.icons: Phosphor Icons (Duotone or Regular weight). Bold, sharp, modern.

motion.philosophy: Functional and fast. No long delays.
motion.interactions: Hover states on all clickable elements. Buttons should slightly scale down (active:scale-95).
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions: 'transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out' for buttons. Avoid 'transition-all'.

login_background.description: Dark, moody barbershop interior with barbers working. Excellent for the login screen background overlay.

barber_avatar_1.description: Confident barber in an apron. Use for Barbeiros module placeholders.

barber_avatar_2.description: Black and white portrait of a barber holding scissors.

accessibility.contrast: Text against background must exceed 4.5:1 ratio. Gold (#D4AF37) against Zinc 950 is highly legible.
accessibility.focus: All inputs and interactive elements must have a visible focus ring.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='sidebar-agendamentos').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building BarberPro, a 100% offline local SQLite desktop-style web app (ERP). Focus on functionality and density.
Implement the UI exclusively in Dark Mode. Follow the Barbershop Noir color palette provided.
All text MUST be in Portuguese (pt-BR). Use 'Faturamento', 'Agendamentos', 'Atendimento Rápido', 'Comissões', 'Estoque', etc.
The login screen should feature the login_background image with a heavy black overlay (bg-black/60) to ensure the login card is the focal point.
The POS (Venda Rápida) module must be built for SPEED. Use a grid of clickable service/product cards with clear prices. No nested dropdowns for frequent actions.
Implement Shadcn UI heavily, but override default styles to match the dark/gold theme. Remove the default rounded-xl borders, use rounded-md or rounded-lg for a sharper look.
Ensure the application layout occupies 100vh with a fixed sidebar and a scrollable main content area.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or headers. Always use solid surfaces (bg-[#18181B]) with 1px borders.
Do not center-align the app container. Dashboards must be left-aligned and fill the available space (w-full).
Install and use 'sonner' for toast notifications. Ensure toast theme is dark.
Use Recharts for the dashboard graphics (Faturamento do dia/mês).

universal_guidelines.avoid_ai_slop: Do not use generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
universal_guidelines.micro_animations: Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
universal_guidelines.spacing: Use generous spacing inside containers, but keep dashboard elements tightly coupled (Mode B).
universal_guidelines.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid. DO NOT omit this.
